content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've recently purchased a [product_name] [article_no] for logging data, but I'm having difficulty determining the appropriate gain and offset values for my sensors. Details: I have four current transducers (0 to 20 A) with outputs ranging from 4-20 mA. These are connected to the main module on the four analog inputs. Since the analog inputs accept 0 to 10V, I placed a 500 ohm resistor in parallel to convert the signal range to 2-10V. I'm unsure how to proceed from this point. I've searched the forum but haven't found an answer yet. Would anyone be able to assist? Best regards, [user_name]
Hello, You might find this helpful: gain and offset calculation for analog amplifiers [version_no] can be found in [document]. Kind regards,
Thanks for sharing the Excel workbook—I'll check it out. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges when setting up analog sensor scaling using the [product_name] Basis Module, especially in calculating accurate gain and offset parameters to ensure correct sensor readings. There is confusion about converting 4-20mA signals to the 0-10V input range and mapping these to module settings. Reference was made to a third-party Excel tool, demonstrating a lack of integrated utilities or comprehensive documentation for configuring these analog inputs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for straightforward guidance or reliable tools to help them calculate and configure gain and offset values for analog sensors, simplifying integration with the module and ensuring dependable operation.
